items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 25 July 2026 at 4:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing overnight.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and low pressure to the northeast of Scotland as weak fronts affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 to 5 falling variable 2 to 4 for a time later this evening, then settling and increasing west or southwest 5 or 6 overnight. Veering west or northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight building slight or moderate for tomorrow.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle, clearing to showers tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in precipitation.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 in places, backing west 4 or 5 overnight into Monday, backing west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
